lines: Tet McMuffins beat the living shit out of DetroitDumpsterFire, 164.0 to 51.5. That's not a matchup, that's a fucking crime scene.
Wilson Weasels dropped 164.1 in week 6. Hottest fucking lineup in the league, and they won't shut up about it.
DetroitDumpsterFire put up a pathetic 51.5. A kicker and a prayer would've scored more.
Tet McMuffins left 21.0 points rotting on the bench with Germie Bernard sitting there while A.J. Brown took a dump. Benching genius.
TheTunaSquad scored 126.4 and still fucking lost. The fantasy gods took a dump on that roster.
